Subject: Update on Department Budget Request

Dear [Recipient Name],

I am writing to provide an update regarding our recent request for a budget increase. We have received feedback that the current proposal does not align with the company’s existing financial strategy, and therefore, the request has been denied at this time.

We understand the importance of adhering to the company’s fiscal priorities. To move forward, we are prepared to resubmit the request with a more comprehensive justification. This revised proposal will include detailed explanations and concrete examples of the anticipated benefits to ensure it better supports our strategic goals.

Please let us know if you would like to schedule a brief meeting to discuss the specific areas where our initial justification fell short, so we can address them effectively in the next iteration.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
